note: Both sets capture the key textual facts (47,402.91 N·m saturation, 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, 1° blade-pitch trigger, gain-scheduled PI, 1173.7 rpm rated speed, high drivetrain damping, no torsional-damping loop), but Set A reads the figure more consistently. Set B introduces two unsupported chart readings: 'Optimal = 0 N·m at 100 rpm' (the optimal curve is at zero at 0 rpm and already positive at 100 rpm) and '1150 rpm = boundary of Region 2.5 and 3' (1150 rpm bounds Regions 2 and 2½, with Region 3 starting near rated speed ~1173.7 rpm). Set B also carries more redundant and mutually inconsistent chart claims (0 N·m over both 0–650 and 0–680 rpm, 20,000 N·m at both 850 and 870 rpm for the same curves, 43,000/50,000/36,000 N·m each stated twice). Set A's weaknesses are mainly duplication (the 0–650 rpm claim twice, 50,000 N·m at 1400 rpm and 0 N·m at 0 rpm each stated twice under 'Optimal' and 'Optimal Controller') and a minor 850 vs 870 rpm inconsistency, so it is the cleaner set overall.
